fusions.name: Bolting Puff
fusions.desc: You bolt to the target, then burst a puffball on it for 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Ringed Pop
fusions.desc: A ring of mushrooms pops around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bolthole Burrow
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. You finish 2 tiles from where you stood, with 8% more dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Fairy Footing
fusions.desc: When you have moved a long way, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
